verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5070 family page documents DLSS Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction and Multi Frame Generation (4X mode) on 50 Series cards, and the DLSS page says the NVIDIA app can update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features. A TechPowerUp review independently confirms DLSS use on the 5070 Ti for 4K, though it does not measure frame generation. missing for 10: independent hands-on testing of Multi Frame Generation on this card, and a concrete game-count or support list beyond 'hundreds of games'.

support.subject: As a gamer, AI upscaling and frame generation are supported on this card — the DLSS or FSR generation is documented for this part, with broad game support

citations.quote: DLSS Super Resolution and DLSS Ray Reconstruction on 40 and 50 Series; Frame Gen on 40 Series. Multi Frame Gen (4X Mode) on 50 Series.
